programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
programme.sub-title: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly | Full EPISODE | Wednesday, June 3, 2026
programme.desc: A new report says many abortion businesses are violating federal rules designed to protect women. Charlotte Lozier Institute says more than a half-dozen online abortion businesses are shipping abortion drugs into states with pro-life laws prohibiting their distribution. The group also says more than 80% of abortion drug sellers make the dangerous drugs available after 10 weeks of pregnancy, flouting FDA guidelines. Charlotte Lozier Institute’s Dr. Ingrid Skop says the study reveals major concerns, and little oversight from the FDA. Plus, Pope Leo delivers pro-family and pro-motherhood messages to a group of lawmakers from the European Parliament. He also ties in the continent’s demographic struggles with Europe’s shift toward anti-Christian policies. Dr. Joseph Meaney from the National Catholic Bioethics Center goes inside the numbers on Europe’s aging population and its increase in both abortion and euthanasia. Several U.S. states push back on so-called “Pride Month” by inaugurating pro-family and pro-life initiatives for June. And how the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion in Wisconsin is celebrating America’s upcoming 250th anniversary with a Catholic twist.

programme.title: Lukas storyteller
programme.sub-title: Madre Teresa y el amor a los demás
programme.desc: Lukas invita a sus amigos a formar parte de una gran aventura en el arrecife oscuro. En cuanto llegan al lugar, todos tienen miedo porque no saben cómo ayudar y acompañar a los viejos amigos que viven ahí. Es entonces cuando llega la hora de contar la historia de Madre Teresa de Calcuta, una Santa que le pedía a Dios que la ayudara a tener un corazón grande para poder amar y ayudar a mucha gente. La historia cambia totalmente la vida de esos pececitos, tanto que regresan al arrecife y descubren un tesoro que solo pueden encontrar con actos de amor.

programme.title: Lukas storyteller
programme.sub-title: San Antonio de Padua y decir la verdad
programme.desc: La feria ha llegado al arrecife y nuestros amigos deberán hacer méritos para poder ir. Peter se mete en problemas y gracias a su hermana, Agnes, Lukas y Noah, aprenderemos una lección sobre la importancia de decir la verdad siguiendo el ejemplo de San Antonio de Padua.

programme.title: Mexico catolico
programme.desc: Episodio sobre el religioso franciscano español Beato Junípero Serra, quien hizo su apostolado misionero en México junto a otros religiosos. En este capitulo se recorren algunas de sus fundaciones y se relatan algunas de sus virtudes apostolicas.

programme.title: Kerigma de amor (novena temporada)
programme.desc: “Les conviene que yo me vaya; porque si no me voy, no vendrá a ustedes el Paráclito; pero si me voy, se lo enviaré”, Juan 16, 7. El Espíritu Santo, la tercera persona de la Santísima Trinidad, es la presencia de Dios permanente en nuestras. Solo falta invocarlo en todo momento y Él actuará.

programme.desc: El Papa León XIV reza el Ángelus desde Roma. Esta oración especial, acompañada del toque de la campana del Ángelus, conmemora la Encarnación de Cristo.

programme.title: Nuestra fe en vivo
programme.desc: Desde Guadalajara, México, nos visita Clara Macías, una mujer a quien desde muy joven Dios la encontró, y desde su juventud ha buscado compartir la experiencia que a ella le cambió la vida. Actualmente está casada y tiene 4 hijos. Y desde ésta realidad continua intensamente anunciando la Buena Nueva por todo el mundo sobre todo teniendo como prioridad los niños, los jóvenes y los matrimonios. ¡No se pierda de la simpatía, carisma y fe de esta mujer de Dios!

programme.desc: En la vida espiritual, experimentamos altos y bajos. San Ignacio de Loyola nos ofrece las Reglas 3 y 4 para entender cómo la consolación y la desolación afectan nuestra relación con Dios y cómo responder a cada una.
